say:1:1110229001:1.text: I think I bumped into something with fur in the sandstorm just now...
say:1:1110229001:1.source_cn: 刚才在沙暴中，好像撞到了什么硬邦邦毛茸茸的东西……

choice_prompt:2:1110229001.text: I think I bumped into something with fur in the sandstorm just now...
choice_prompt:2:1110229001.source_cn: 刚才在沙暴中，好像撞到了什么硬邦邦毛茸茸的东西……

say:3:1110229002:1.text: A spider?! I'm glad I didn't open my eyes.
say:3:1110229002:1.source_cn: 蜘蛛！幸好萨忒娜没睁开眼睛细看！

say:4:1110229003:1.text: Why are you here? Are you also here for the trial?
say:4:1110229003:1.source_cn: 你怎么会在这里？也是来进行试炼的吗？

say:5:1110229004:1.text: No, it's because of the sandstorm that I'm here by chance...
say:5:1110229004:1.source_cn: 并非如此。唉，我被沙暴卷到这里纯属偶然……

say:6:1110229005:1.text: I was following the Crystal Ignis, but I didn't realize it would lead me into a lair of spiders.
say:6:1110229005:1.source_cn: 明明是跟随了炎晶之眼的指引，没想到却踏进了这都是蜘蛛的...

say:8:1110229007:1.text: There is someone I must find. The Crystal Ignis guided me here... This must mean that our fates are intertwined somehow.
say:8:1110229007:1.source_cn: 嗯，我有一定要找到的人。任凭炎晶之眼把我指引到了这里…...

say:9:1110229008:1.text: Let me try a divination. I'm quite skilled at reading fortunes. Maybe I can see into your future, and it might just help me figure out mine too.
say:9:1110229008:1.source_cn: 那么请让我为你们进行占卜吧！萨忒娜是个很厉害的占卜师，...

say:10:1110229009:1.text: I've never received a divination before. What do I need to do? Should I close my eyes?
say:10:1110229009:1.source_cn: 还没有人给我占卜过，我要做些什么？要闭上眼睛吗？还是……

say:11:1110229010:2.text: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
say:11:1110229010:2.source_cn: ——先从您开始吧，刚才施法救了我的魔法师！让我看看你的过去？
say:11:1110229010:2.male: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
say:11:1110229010:2.female: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.

choice_prompt:12:1110229010.text: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
choice_prompt:12:1110229010.source_cn: ——先从您开始吧，刚才施法救了我的魔法师！让我看看你的过去？
choice_prompt:12:1110229010.male: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
choice_prompt:12:1110229010.female: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.

say:13:1110229011:2.text: Please look into my eyes. In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine. Through spiritual eyes, clear and bright, we see beyond the shroud of night
say:13:1110229011:2.source_cn: 请看着我的眼睛。灵视之眼，上溯那不被世俗遮蔽的时光之流...
say:13:1110229011:2.male: Please look into my eyes. In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine. Through spiritual eyes, clear and bright, we see beyond the shroud of night
say:13:1110229011:2.female: Please look into my eyes. In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine. Through spiritual eyes, clear and bright, we see beyond the shroud of night

say:14:1110229012:1.text: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
say:14:1110229012:1.source_cn: 不对！不应该是这样的……为什么……我什么都没看到！
say:14:1110229012:1.male: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
say:14:1110229012:1.female: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!

choice_prompt:15:1110229012.text: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
choice_prompt:15:1110229012.source_cn: 不对！不应该是这样的……为什么……我什么都没看到！
choice_prompt:15:1110229012.male: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
choice_prompt:15:1110229012.female: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!

say:16:1110229013:1.text: This has never happened before! My spiritual sight has never failed me!
say:16:1110229013:1.source_cn: 什么？我的灵视居然什么没……不不不，从来没发生过这种事！
say:16:1110229013:1.male: This has never happened before! My spiritual sight has never failed me!
say:16:1110229013:1.female: This has never happened before! My spiritual sight has never failed me!

say:18:1110229014:1.text: You can't see the magister's past? This lady is a charlatan!
say:18:1110229014:1.source_cn: 没有看到主人的过去，不会是骗子吧？
say:18:1110229014:1.male: You can't see the magister's past? This lady is a charlatan!
say:18:1110229014:1.female: You can't see the magister's past? This lady is a charlatan!

say:19:1110229015:1.text: No, she's not. Because of this, I think she actually has some talent.
say:19:1110229015:1.source_cn: 不，正因如此，我反倒觉得这位占卜师没准有点天赋……

say:21:1110229017:1.text: I must be really worn out. That's the only explanation I can come up with. Yeah, that's gotta be it.
say:21:1110229017:1.source_cn: 嗯，一定是我太疲惫了！一定是这样！

say:22:1110229018:1.text: Let's just forget about what just happened. I'm actually more skilled at prophecy than divination.
say:22:1110229018:1.source_cn: 没关系！刚才的插曲请大家忘掉！其实比起占卜，我更擅长的...

say:25:1110229021:1.text: Hey! Don't give me that look! Just give me another shot to show what I can do, okay?
say:25:1110229021:1.source_cn: 两位这躲闪的眼神是怎么回事！再给我一次机会，证明我的实...

say:26:1110229022:1.text: Here, give me your hands! I see...
say:26:1110229022:1.source_cn: 来，两位请把手给我！我……看见……

say:27:1110229023:0.text: On the high peak where eagles soar... sleeps the eternal will... the summit is drenched in blood... the stranger hides in darkness...
say:27:1110229023:0.source_cn: 雄鹰盘旋的高高山峰之上，沉睡着永恒的意志……鲜血浇灌的...

say:28:1110229024:0.text: The bond of siblings... life and death, honor and strength are revealed in the thunder...
say:28:1110229024:0.source_cn: 双生的羁绊……生与死，荣誉与力量，在落雷中昭示……

say:29:1110229025:1.text: The high peak and the summit? Does that refer to Mars Peak?

say:30:1110229026:1.text: And also the blood... who's blood?

say:31:1110229027:1.text: Whew... Sorry, I think I spaced out for a second. I'll prepare to give you your prophecy now.

choice_prompt:32:1110229027.text: Whew... Sorry, I think I spaced out for a second. I'll prepare to give you your prophecy now.

say:33:1110229028:1.text: What?! Really?! I don't recall anything... Could one of the gods have spoken through me?
say:33:1110229028:1.source_cn: 什么？！我……什么都没说啊？莫非是我接收到了神灵的意旨吗？

say:34:1110229029:1.text: It seems that my spiritual power has gotten stronger. This time, I have a hunch that I'll see her again!
say:34:1110229029:1.source_cn: 看来我的灵力更强了！这次我有预感，我很快就能再见到她了！

say:35:1110229030:1.text: Alright, everyone. Farewell! I'm sure we will meet again under the setting sun.
say:35:1110229030:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，萨忒娜向各位道别。无需远送，残阳映照下，我们...

say:37:1110229016:1.text: This feels odd. Maybe it's because I'm exhausted from the sandstorm, and my spiritual abilities are weakened.
say:37:1110229016:1.source_cn: 好奇怪？或许是因为我在沙暴中太过疲惫，灵力有点不足了吧。

choice:2:1:2.text: What do you think it was?
choice:2:1:2.male: What do you think it was?
choice:2:1:2.female: What do you think it was?
